findings.detail: Arrowhead issuer_name should be Arrowhead Holdco Company; extracted value leaked industry, debt type, rate, floor, and maturity text into issuer_name.
Ultimate Baked Goods issuer_name should be Ultimate Baked Goods Midco LLC; extracted value leaked industry and terms into issuer_name.
PODS S+300 issuer_name should be PODS, LLC; extracted value leaked industry and terms into issuer_name.
PODS S+400 row is a continuation under PODS/PODS, LLC; extracted value leaked industry and terms into issuer_name instead of carrying forward the issuer.
DCA issuer_name should be DCA Investment Holding LLC; extracted value leaked industry, alternate label, rate, floor, and maturity text into issuer_name.
PPL issuer_name should be PPL Acquisition LLC; extracted value leaked industry, label, investment type, rate, floor, and maturity text into issuer_name.

rationale: C206 is a real issuer_name parse leak. For each flagged holding, the raw SOI row has a clean issuer/company cell and separate columns for investment type, interest rate/floor, and maturity date; the extracted issuer_name instead concatenated industry/path and those term columns into the issuer field. The cited source rows ground the specific affected records. No aggregate anchor is needed for this row-level/cell-level defect.
